```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)

# Load functions 
source(
  here::here(
    "3-scripts",
    "1-functions.r"
  )
)

# Load the saved study area. Call get_study_area() explicitly to update it.
study_area <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "study_area.rds"))

bin = 2000
```

```{r}

study_map <-
  tm_basemap("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") +
  tm_shape(study_area) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill_alpha = 0,
    col = "red",
    lwd = 2
  ) +
  tm_layout(
    inner.margins = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
  ) +
  tm_title("Pensacola Bay System")

tmap_save(
  tm = study_map,
  filename = here::here(
    "4-tables-and-figures",
    "maps",
    "study_area.png"
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

study_map
```


# Load and process saved water-quality data

## Chlorophyll-a

```{r}
chla_raw <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "raw", "chla_raw.rds"))

```

```{r}
# check that all units are same
table(chla_raw$Result_MeasureUnit)

# inspect data for extreme outliers
view(find_outliers(chla_raw))


```


```{r}
# Process Data
chla_proc <- proc_sf_wq_data(
  wq_data = chla_raw, 
  study_area = study_area,
  output_name = "chla_proc", 
  bin_size = bin)

# Plot Data Distribution
param_means_hist(chla_proc, "Chlorophyll-a (µg/L)", "Chl_a")

# Plot Spatial Distribution
param_means_map(chla_proc, "Chlorophyll-a (µg/L)", "Chl_a", study_area)

```

## Salinity

```{r}

salinity_raw <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "raw", "salinity_raw.rds"))

```


Clean data before processing for interpolation
```{r}
# check units to make sure all are comparable
table(salinity_raw$Result_MeasureUnit)

view(find_outliers(salinity_raw))

```

```{r}

# Process Data
sal_proc <- proc_sf_wq_data(
  wq_data = salinity_raw, 
  study_area = study_area, 
  output_name = "sal_proc",
  bin_size = bin)

# Plot Data Distribution
param_means_hist(sal_proc, "Salinity (ppt)", "Sal")

# View Spatial Distribution
param_means_map(sal_proc, "Salinity (ppt)", "Sal", study_area)

```


## Water Temperature

```{r}
water_temp_raw <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "raw", "water_temp_raw.rds"))
```

### Clean Water Temp Data
```{r}
# check units
table(water_temp_raw$Result_MeasureUnit)

#view(find_outliers(water_temp_raw))

# remove extreme outliers
water_temp_raw <- water_temp_raw %>% filter(Result_Measure < 100)
```

### Run Processing Script 
```{r}
water_temp_proc <- proc_sf_wq_data(
  wq_data = water_temp_raw,
  study_area = study_area,
  output_name = "water_temp_proc", 
  bin_size = bin
  ) 

# Plot Data Distribution
param_means_hist(water_temp_proc, "Water Temperature (°C)", "Temp")

# View Spatial Distribution
param_means_map(water_temp_proc, "Water Temperature (°C)", "Temp", study_area)

#rm(water_temp_raw)
```


## Dissolved Oxygen

```{r}
do_raw <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "raw", "do.rds"))
```

### Clean DO Data
```{r}
# check units
hist(do_raw$Result_Measure)

table(do_raw$Result_MeasureUnit)

view(find_outliers(do_raw))

```

### Process DO Data
```{r}

do_proc <- proc_sf_wq_data(
  wq_data = do_raw,
  study_area = study_area,
  output_name = "do_proc", 
  bin_size = bin)

# Plot Data Distribution
param_means_hist(do_proc, "Dissolved Oxygen (mg/L)", "DO")

# View Spatial Distribution
param_means_map(do_proc, "Dissolved Oxygen (mg/L)", "DO", study_area)

#rm(do_raw)

```

```{r}
wq_summary <- bind_rows(
  sal_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Salinity (ppt)"),
  do_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Dissolved Oxygen (mg/L)"),
  chla_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Chlorophyll-a (µg/L)"),
  turbidity_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Turbidity (NTU)"),
  water_temp_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Temperature (°C)")
)

saveRDS(wq_summary, here::here("4-tables-and-figures", "tables", "processed_wq_data_summary.rds"))
```

## Oyster Reefs

https://gis.myfwc.com/hosting/rest/services/Open_Data/Oyster_Beds_Statewide/MapServer/17/query?outFields=*&where=1%3D1&f=geojson

```{r}

oyster_reefs <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "oys_proc.rds"))

tm_basemap("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") +
    tm_shape(oyster_reefs, bbox = study_area) +
    tm_dots(
      col = "black",
      size = 0.5,
      lwd = 0.5,
      fill.legend = tm_legend(
        title = "PBS Oyster Reefs",
        title.fontface = 2,
        #position = c("left", "bottom"),
        position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom", pos.h = "center"),
        orientation = "landscape",
        show = TRUE
      )
    ) +
    tm_shape(study_area, bbox = study_area) +
    tm_borders(
      col = "red"
    ) +
    tm_layout(
      inner.margins = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    ) +
    tm_title("Oyster Beds in Pensacola Bay System", fontface = 2) +
    tm_compass(type = "8star")
```
